acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, a garage conversion typically requires building permits in Garden City and other service areas like Meridian, Eagle, and Kuna. Maine Results, Inc. can help you understand the specific permit requirements for your location and assist with the application process to ensure your project proceeds smoothly and legally.
